name: Pier 39
summary_en: Pier 39's file is mostly environmental review of its development. A 1976 city planning EIR and a 1977 federal environmental statement describe the plan for Pier 39: about 200,000 square feet of new retail — 133,000 square feet of food service and 67,000 square feet of shops — plus a "people mover" circling the pier and marina berthing for sport-fishing and small boats. A 1988 draft EIR covers the Underwater World aquarium proposed at Pier 39. An Arts Commission agenda records Pier 39 management exploring hosting the Cheemah sculpture at East Park, pending Port and BCDC approval. The pier is operated by the Port of San Francisco, whose FY2025 budget line is $156M; no contract in this data names it.
